profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
Software developer with 18 years of experience in .Net software development and 3 years of team leadership, I specialize in driving iterative improvements and optimizing systems to solve customer pain points, particularly in areas related to relational database performance.

I have worked in primarily remote roles since 2013 and have demonstrated the ability to build productive relationships with team members in disparate geographic locations.

Experienced mentoring junior developers, performing code reviews, architecting application database designs, and working with requirements analysts and QA.

Experienced with both Windows and Web, including REST Apis with Angular front ends. Strong database background, proficient in optimizing stored procedures and evaluating the tradeoffs of database logic versus front-end logic for reports and applications.

C#, VB.Net, .NET Framework , .NET 5+, JQuery, HTML, CSS, SQL, WebForms, WinForms, ASP.Net, RESTApis, WindowsServices, SQL Server, Oracle, Angular with Typescript, MaterialUI, EntityFramework, SSRS, GitHub, GitExtensions

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Analyzed performance issues with Sql Server database used by Debt Manager, the state-wide collections system. Identified and implemented improvements to indices and the queries used by ETLS and reports.
 - Evaluated potential training materials for IT support of collections system. 
 - Designed and developed Salesforce integration for batch query and upset jobs.
 - Developed letter templates for collection system.
 - Developed new SSRS reports for various applications, including Debt Manager.
 - Modified existing reports for Debt Manager
 - Improved existing report performance where needed. For example, one report's execution time was reduced from over an hour to only minutes.

technology used
Sql Server Monitor, SSRS, MSSQL, C# .Net 8, Salesforce BulkApi 2.0, GitHub, ALM, Velocity Script

positions.title: Software Engineering Specialist
positions.description:
Hands-on software engineering lead of three full-time software engineers, one test automation engineer, and one software engineering contractor.  

•	Trained interns and new developers
•	Helped experienced developers modernize their skillset
•	Assisted team with troubleshooting
•	Performed code reviews
•	Conducted bi-weekly one-on-ones and advised manager on performance reviews
•	Conducted interviews and advised manager on job posting and interview content
•	Defined strategic priorities in support of leader initiatives. Developed quarterly roadmap.
•	Groomed Jira backlog; managed work with Jira Initiatives, Epics, Stories, and Tasks; wrote functional and technical requirements
•	With input from process engineers and leaders, prioritized and planned sprints.
•	Implemented incremental improvements to developer practices.
•	Managed releases in Jira and GitHub, coordinated efforts for deployments with team members, sent out release notes to customers, 
•	Led team in efforts to:
        o	Develop new functionality to support customers in the Digital Workspace Technology area 
        o	Iteratively modernize ASP.Net WebForms, MVC, and classic ASP applications to a .Net 5 REST Api with Angular12 architecture
        o	Eliminate technical debt by refactoring, rewriting, rearchitecting, and normalizing databases as appropriate
        o	Incorporate unit testing and endpoint testing


Tech Tools: C#, .Net 5, WinForms,  MVC, REST Apis, Jquery, Angular12,  Material UI, SQL Server, Jira, GitHub, SwaggerUI, Postman, SSRS, ServiceNow, ServiceNow API integration

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
o	As part of a team of about ten Agile .Net software engineers, supported RosterApps, an SaaS WebForms application servicing airline ground crew management
o	Led effort to resolve stalled release cycle, switch to 2-week sprints, and setup auto-deployments.
o	Helped bring non-versioned parts of the system into the same branching process.
o	Helped upgrade half of the customers into the latest code base.

Tech Tools: C#, ASP.NET WebForms, Jquery, Angular, WebAPI, WCF, SSRS, SQL Server, BitBucket, Jira

positions.title: Application Development Manager
positions.description:
Provided guidance to small software teams, including on and off-shore contractors, regarding batch job processing design, application design and development, deployment processes, security compliance, and Disaster Recovery / Business Continuity plans. 

Reviewed junior developer performance and provided feedback to them and their managers.  

Advised managers on future project scope, project stack, and team resource allocation. Conducted technical hiring interviews and gave feedback to hiring managers. 

Performed informal code reviews on an as-needed basis.  

Worked closely with business analysts, quality assurance, and developers to ensure releases fully met functional requirements.  

Analyzed business requirements and prepared technical specifications for upcoming releases.  Provided level of effort estimates to managers and project managers.  

Acted as lead developer for enhancements to the LTC rate calculation engine, allowing already approved rate increases to move into production. 

Led effort to migrate AdminServer team from PVCS and IVS repositories to GitLab version control. Provided plan and training for new version control and deployment process. Advised on how to retain needed information within  Git for SOX audits. Advised on how to integrate Agile principles into their highly regulated processes.  

Led effort POC to migrate AdminServer from WebSphere to JBOSS. Moved the build process into Jenkins and oversaw contractor who made the necessary programming changes.  

Designed solutions for data anonymization of Claims Workbook and ECS  applications. Led development effort, doing all PL/SQL development and providing guidance to off-shore contractors regarding Informatica automation.  

Technologies: VP / MS, SQL Server, Oracle, Informatica, Appworx, VB.Net,  Java, PowerShell, Jenkins, Gitlab, SQL Server Agent, Crystal Reports, Appworx, ServiceNow

positions.title: Application Development Analyst
positions.description:
o  Brought stability to in-house .Net life and annuity claims application. Originally, it locked daily and was slated for retirement.  In a year, lock-ups ceased and it became the preferred claims processing tool.
o  Retired legacy life and annuity claims system, migrating all active policy block functionality and data into the newly stabilized .Net system.
o  Migrated team version control from TFS to Git and improved branching structure, which allowed multiple parallel release efforts.
o  Overhauled nightly batch jobs, improving logging and nearly eliminating off-hour support calls.
o  Overhauled the authentication and authorization module of the life and annuity application, bringing password management under standard SSO policy.
o  Developed SQL training and taught to hundreds of colleagues throughout the company.

Tech Tools: VB.Net, C#, WinForms, SQL Server, SQL Server Agent, Oracle, Crystal Reports, AppWorx, Informatica, TFS, GitLab, ServiceNow
